findingIds: Packet scope and reconciliation: all 108 baseline items are affected; 108 were reconciled exactly once, comprising 91 exact-match/mismatch, 6 normalized-match/mismatch, 3 exact-match/accurately-unavailable, and 8 missing-from-source/accurately-unavailable items.

Terra correctly found that Luna's deterministic baseline-only count of 11 is overstated. Moët & Chandon, Monemvasia Winery Tsimbidi Anthosmias, and Ruinart Rosé are explicitly present on the current official Wine List, leaving 8 rather than 11 baseline-only items.

The official menu is incomplete as an ingredient disclosure and contains no allergen matrix. It cannot establish complete allergen arrays, allergen negatives, or may-contain and shared-equipment conclusions.

The raw-or-undercooked-food notice concerns foodborne illness and is not cross-contact evidence. The deterministic cross_contact gate therefore indicates unresolved evidence, not confirmed cross-contact.

Three restaurant-linked PDFs still return retrieval errors. This supports an extraction-risk finding, but not a claim that the corresponding brunch and dinner services are absent: substantial current content for those services is exposed in the official HTML.

Narrow positive allergen evidence remains valid where the official menu explicitly names ingredients or unavoidable identities—for example feta or cheese supports milk, sesame seeds support sesame, eggs support egg, and named fish or prawns support fish or shellfish.

Terra's blanket unavailable arrays miss additional narrow positive discrepancies for baseline items with empty arrays despite unavoidable identities, including Black Sea Bass, Bronzino, both Chilean Sea Bass spellings, Fagri identified as pink snapper, Royal Dorado under Whole Fish, Swordfish Kebab, and Tiger Prawns.
Rejected any interpretation of Terra's empty adjudicated allergen arrays as negative evidence or as grounds to erase restaurant-issued positive ingredients and unavoidable named identities.
Rejected the deterministic baselineOnlyCount of 11; current primary evidence reduces it to 8.

Rejected treating the inaccessible_source gate as proof that six menu surfaces are inaccessible. Its own metrics report zero inaccessible surfaces and one inaccessible primary attempt, while the current HTML exposes the relevant service content; only three linked PDF artifacts failed extraction in this review.
Rejected promotion of menu descriptions into complete ingredient lists, complete allergen arrays, allergen-free claims, or cross-contact conclusions.
Rejected culinary-assumption promotion beyond explicit ingredients and unavoidable identities; preparation-dependent allergens remain unavailable without stronger restaurant-issued evidence.
